events.to: Held: waiting for Brandt's December statement

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Sabrina, I'm Claudia. I'll stay quiet while you work and ask a quick question when something interesting happens.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You moved the drill press from opex to capex. What made you change it?

transcript.speaker: expert
transcript.text: Equipment over five thousand euros is always capex. And no asset number, no capex booking.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Got it: over five thousand is capex, and it needs an asset number.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That one's only 1,950 euros. Why send it for a second approval?

transcript.speaker: expert
transcript.text: It's from our Czech subsidiary. Anything from Brno goes to a second approver, no matter the amount.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Makes sense: the Czech subsidiary always gets a second approval.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You held the Brandt freight invoice. What's the issue?

transcript.speaker: expert
transcript.text: Brandt bills December twice almost every year. I hold it until their statement arrives.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Understood. Brandt's December invoices wait for the statement.
